values.title: Project structure
values.summary: The files Tessera adds to your repo and what each one is for.
values.body:
## The default layout

Project

```
my-app/
├─ schema.ts          # tables, relations, rules
├─ seed.ts            # optional sample data
├─ functions/         # server functions
│  └─ welcome-email.ts
├─ tessera/           # generated client (do not edit)
├─ migrations/        # applied migration history
└─ tessera.config.ts  # project settings
```

## Files you edit

### schema.ts

The single source of truth for your data model. Every table, column, relation and rule lives here, so reviews of data changes happen in one file.

### functions/

Each file exports one function. The file name becomes the function name, for example `welcome-email`.

### tessera.config.ts

Project-level settings: regions, auth providers, preview branch behaviour and function runtimes.

## Generated files

The `tessera/` folder is regenerated on every `tessera push` and `tessera generate`. Commit it so CI and teammates build without running the CLI.

Migrations are history

Files in `migrations/` record what was applied to each environment. Don’t edit them by hand; create a new migration instead.
